warnings: One of 3 views on this sheet; siblings are the balcony plan (_view1_balcony_plan.json) and guardrail section (_view3_guardrail_section.json).

Guardrail height (0.80m, four equal 0.20m bands: top rail + FB picket + two lower 1x1 rails) sits atop a balcony parapet upstand (shown as a solid band below the rail zone in this elevation, detailed further in view3's section) — combined guard height above balcony floor is not summed on this view alone.

This is a genuinely different guardrail assembly from ST.2's stair handrail (หน้า22): here it's a full 0.80m box-steel-tube balcony guard (three horizontal members), there it was a single 2"x4" wood cap rail on stacked flat-bar balusters. Both share the same 'เหล็กแบน(FB) 1" x 6mm oil-painted' component spec, suggesting a shared material stock across different assemblies.
